analysis.summary:
ISSUES
Critical:
- The "How It Works" page failed the performance test, with a duration of 907ms. To improve this, consider optimizing images, minifying CSS and JavaScript, and enabling browser caching.
insights: The homepage has a longer load time (825ms) compared to the pricing page (198ms) and blog page (210ms). This could be due to heavier content or slower server response times.
The TTFB (Time to First Byte) for the pricing page (62ms) is higher than the blog page (10ms), indicating potential server-side issues.
Ensuring consistent performance across all pages is essential for a positive user experience. Regularly monitoring and addressing performance issues will help maintain optimal website performance.
